label: Time-varying alcohol by volume used for distilled spirits
definition: Alcohol-by-volume fraction NIAAA assigns to distilled spirits for the state and year in its time-varying ABV method.
notes: Published as ABV x 1000; stored as a fraction.

label: Apparent consumption, gallons of wine (beverage volume)

notes: Published as ABV x 1000; stored as a fraction.

label: Time-varying alcohol by volume used for beer

notes: Published as ABV x 1000; stored as a fraction.

label: Apparent consumption, gallons of ethanol from distilled spirits
definition: Gallons of pure ethanol from distilled spirits, converted from beverage volume with NIAAA's standard ethanol conversion factors.

label: Gallons of ethanol from distilled spirits, time-varying ABV method
definition: Gallons of ethanol from distilled spirits using NIAAA's time-varying ABV estimates instead of fixed conversion factors.

label: Apparent consumption per capita age 14 and older, gallons of ethanol (distilled spirits)
definition: Gallons of ethanol from distilled spirits divided by NIAAA's population age 14 and older. Published x 10,000; stored in gallons.
notes: Per resident of that age, not per drinker. Never divide by a drinking prevalence to get consumption per drinker.

label: Apparent consumption per capita age 21 and older, gallons of ethanol (distilled spirits)

notes: Per resident of that age, not per drinker. Never divide by a drinking prevalence to get consumption per drinker.

label: Drank any alcohol in the past month (1995-1999 questionnaire item)
definition: Percent of adults answering yes to 'During the past month, have you had at least one drink of any alcoholic beverage?' (BRFSS item DRINKANY). Published crude prevalence, Overall break-out.
notes: Prevalence of a behavior, not quantity consumed. 1995-2010 and 2011+ estimates are in different comparability groups.

label: Drank any alcohol in the past 30 days
definition: Percent of adults who have had at least one drink of alcohol within the past 30 days (BRFSS calculated variables DRNKANY2-DRNKANY6). Published crude prevalence, Overall break-out.
notes: Prevalence of a behavior, not quantity consumed. 1995-2010 and 2011+ estimates are in different comparability groups.

label: Binge drinking, 5+ drinks on one occasion (same threshold for men and women)
definition: Percent of adults having five or more drinks on one occasion in the past 30 days (BRFSS _RFBINGE, _RFBING2, _RFBING3; 1995-2005). Published crude prevalence, Overall break-out.
notes: Prevalence of a behavior, not quantity consumed. 1995-2010 and 2011+ estimates are in different comparability groups.

label: Binge drinking, 5+ drinks (men) / 4+ drinks (women) on one occasion
definition: Percent of adults: men having five or more, women four or more drinks on one occasion in the past 30 days (BRFSS _RFBING4-_RFBING6; 2006 onward). Published crude prevalence, Overall break-out.
notes: Prevalence of a behavior, not quantity consumed. 1995-2010 and 2011+ estimates are in different comparability groups.

label: Heavy drinking, more than 2 drinks/day (men) or 1/day (women)
definition: Percent of adult men having more than two drinks per day and adult women more than one drink per day (BRFSS _RFDRHVY, _RFDRHV2-_RFDRHV4; 2001-2014). Published crude prevalence, Overall break-out.
notes: Prevalence of a behavior, not quantity consumed. 1995-2010 and 2011+ estimates are in different comparability groups.

label: Heavy drinking, more than 14 drinks/week (men) or 7/week (women)
definition: Percent of adult men having more than 14 drinks per week and adult women more than 7 drinks per week (BRFSS _RFDRHV5-_RFDRHV9; 2015 onward). Published crude prevalence, Overall break-out.
notes: Prevalence of a behavior, not quantity consumed. 1995-2010 and 2011+ estimates are in different comparability groups.

label: Chronic drinking, more than 60 drinks in the past month
definition: Percent of adults having more than 60 alcoholic beverages in the past month (BRFSS _RFDRCHR; 1995-1999). Published crude prevalence, Overall break-out.
notes: Prevalence of a behavior, not quantity consumed. 1995-2010 and 2011+ estimates are in different comparability groups.

label: State alcoholic beverage sales taxes (Census T10)
definition: Census item T10: taxes on sale of alcoholic beverages, whether collected through government-operated liquor stores or private outlets. State government only.
overlap_note: Excludes state liquor store profits (Census liquor store revenue) and general sales tax on alcohol. Not wine-only.
notes: Published in thousands of dollars; stored in dollars (multiplier 1000).

label: State alcoholic beverage license taxes (Census T20)
definition: Census item T20: licenses for manufacturing, importing, wholesaling and retailing of alcoholic beverages. State government only.
overlap_note: Separate from T10; local licenses excluded.

label: State total taxes (Census C105)
definition: Census C105 total taxes of the state government, all tax types.
overlap_note: Contains T10 and T20.

label: CPI-U, U.S. city average, all items (NSA)
definition: Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers, U.S. city average, all items, not seasonally adjusted (BLS series CUUR0000SA0), monthly.

label: DABS revenue from liquor sales
definition: 'Revenue from Liquor Sales' in the DABS five-year financial summary: sales of liquor (spirits, wine, heavy beer, flavored malt beverages) by state liquor stores and package agencies.
overlap_note: Before sales tax: the reports' Note B says sales are reported at published prices with sales taxes excluded (FY2016 and FY2019 reports) and that sales taxes are liabilities, not revenues (FY2021 report). Before the statutory school-meals and enforcement deposits, which the audited Alcoholic Beverage Services Fund does not count as its revenue (see ut_abs_fund_sales_revenue). The FY2012-FY2019 reports label the line 'Sales net of Taxes'. Excludes beer sold by private grocery and convenience stores.
notes: Utah state fiscal year (July-June). Transcribed by hand; published in thousands of dollars.

label: DABS gross profit
definition: 'Gross Profits' in the DABS five-year financial summary: liquor sales revenue less cost of liquor sold.
overlap_note: Subset of liquor sales revenue.
notes: Utah state fiscal year (July-June). Transcribed by hand; published in thousands of dollars.

label: DABS net profit for transfer to the General Fund
definition: 'Net Profit for Transfer to General Fund' in the DABS five-year financial summary.
overlap_note: After operating expenses and after the separately listed program transfers (school lunch, public safety, prevention). Do not add those transfers to it a second time.
notes: Utah state fiscal year (July-June). Transcribed by hand; published in thousands of dollars.

label: DABS transfer to School Lunch / Uniform School Fund
definition: 'Less School Lunch/Uniform School Fund' in the DABS five-year financial summary.
overlap_note: Deducted before net profit for transfer to the General Fund: additive to it, not contained in it.
notes: Utah state fiscal year (July-June). Transcribed by hand; published in thousands of dollars.

label: Sales tax reported by DABS
definition: 'Sales Tax' in the DABS five-year financial summary. The FY2025 report's letter attributes $32.4 million of sales tax revenue to local municipalities; whether the line is all sales tax on DABS sales or only the local share is unresolved.
overlap_note: Not part of DABS profit. Scope (state vs local share) unresolved; see docs/fiscal-reconciliation.md.
notes: Utah state fiscal year (July-June). Transcribed by hand; published in thousands of dollars.

label: DABS other income
definition: 'Other Income' (five-year summary) / 'Other Income (e.g. Fees)' (income statement).
overlap_note: Added to gross profit to give total revenue.
notes: Utah state fiscal year (July-June). Transcribed by hand; published in thousands of dollars.

label: DABS total revenue
definition: 'Total Revenue' (five-year summary tables) / 'Total Operating Revenue' (income statement): gross profit plus other income.
overlap_note: Gross profit plus other income; not gross sales.
notes: Utah state fiscal year (July-June). Transcribed by hand; published in thousands of dollars.

label: DABS Parents Empowered deduction
definition: 'Less Parents Empowered' in the five-year summary (underage drinking prevention media campaign).
overlap_note: Deducted before net profit.
notes: Utah state fiscal year (July-June). Transcribed by hand; published in thousands of dollars.

label: DABS transfer to Underage Drinking Prevention Program
definition: 'Less Underage Drinking Prevention Program' in the five-year summary.
overlap_note: Deducted before net profit.
notes: Utah state fiscal year (July-June). Transcribed by hand; published in thousands of dollars.

label: DABS operating expenses (five-year summary row printed as operating and non-operating)
definition: The five-year summary row printed 'Less Operating and Non-Operating Expenses' ('Less Operating Expenses' in the 81st report). In FY2024 and FY2025, the years checked, it equals the income statement's Total Operating Expenses and so excludes depreciation, amortization and interest, which that statement lists as non-operating. It is not total expenses; the identifier keeps the printed wording for compatibility.
overlap_note: Deducted before net profit.
notes: Utah state fiscal year (July-June). Transcribed by hand; published in thousands of dollars.

definition: 'Less Transfer to SBI' in the five-year summary. The report does not expand 'SBI'.
overlap_note: Deducted before net profit.
notes: Utah state fiscal year (July-June). Transcribed by hand; published in thousands of dollars.

notes: Per resident age 21+, not per drinker.

definition: Census T10 multiplied by (CPI-U calendar-2024 average / CPI-U average over the 12 months of the state's fiscal year). Requires all 12 fiscal-year months and all 12 months of 2024.
notes: Fiscal-period matched deflator (not a calendar-year approximation). Missing if any needed CPI month is unavailable.

label: Tennessee wine tax collections (Department of Revenue account 11002, 'Wine Tax')
definition: Collections received by the Tennessee Department of Revenue in the fiscal year under account 11002, printed 'Wine Tax' in the June Summary of Collections through the FY2017 report. Collections basis, before any distribution to local governments. From the FY2018 report the same account is printed 'Wine Tax & High Alcohol Beer' and is kept as a separate measure.
overlap_note: Part of the ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES class total. Covers wine sold through every channel; no account isolates retail food stores. How the account maps into Census T10 is not documented here.
notes: Tennessee state fiscal year (July-June). Parsed from the fiscal-year-to-date page of the June Summary of Collections; collections basis, in dollars as printed.

label: Tennessee account 11002 collections, printed 'Wine Tax & High Alcohol Beer'
definition: Collections received by the Tennessee Department of Revenue in the fiscal year under account 11002 as printed from the FY2018 report on: 'Wine Tax & High Alcohol Beer'. Not wine-only. Collections basis, before any distribution to local governments.
overlap_note: Continues account 11002 under a wider label; do not join it to the wine-only series as one trend. Part of the ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES class total.
notes: Tennessee state fiscal year (July-June). Parsed from the fiscal-year-to-date page of the June Summary of Collections; collections basis, in dollars as printed.

label: Tennessee winery wine tax collections (account 11013)
definition: Collections received by the Tennessee Department of Revenue in the fiscal year under account 11013, printed 'Wine Tax' through the FY2017 report and 'Wine Tax (Winery)' from FY2018. Treated as one account because the code is unchanged; the label change splits its comparability group. Collections basis.
overlap_note: Separate from account 11002. Part of the ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES class total.
notes: Tennessee state fiscal year (July-June). Parsed from the fiscal-year-to-date page of the June Summary of Collections; collections basis, in dollars as printed.

label: Tennessee wine enforcement tax collections (account 11018)
definition: Collections received by the Tennessee Department of Revenue in the fiscal year under account 11018, printed 'Wine Enforcement Tax'. Collections basis.
overlap_note: Separate from account 11002. Part of the ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES class total.
notes: Tennessee state fiscal year (July-June). Parsed from the fiscal-year-to-date page of the June Summary of Collections; collections basis, in dollars as printed.

label: Tennessee ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES class total (Department of Revenue)
definition: Total of every account printed under the ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES class of tax on the fiscal-year-to-date page of the June Summary of Collections (alcohol tax, wine taxes, licenses, brand registration, enforcement taxes and smaller accounts). Excludes the separate BEER and MIXED DRINK classes. Collections basis.
overlap_note: Contains accounts 11002, 11013 and 11018. Excludes beer taxes and the mixed drink (liquor-by-the-drink) tax, which are separate classes.
notes: Tennessee state fiscal year (July-June). Parsed from the fiscal-year-to-date page of the June Summary of Collections; collections basis, in dollars as printed.

label: State liquor-store receipts (Census A90)
definition: Census item A90: amounts received from the sale of liquor and other miscellaneous revenue of government-maintained alcoholic beverage monopoly systems, excluding any taxes the system collects for its own or other governments. Census 'liquor stores' are the alcoholic beverage distribution facilities of government monopoly systems, wholesale-only ones included; a value never codes the retail system. Beverage scope follows each state's monopoly and differs by state and year.
overlap_note: Gross of the cost of liquor sold and of operating costs; not a profit. Excludes alcohol taxes collected through the stores (Census counts those as taxes, e.g. T10). Includes miscellaneous revenue of the system.
notes: State government only. Census survey fiscal year (state's own fiscal year). Published in thousands of dollars; stored in dollars (multiplier 1000). FY1972 and FY1977-FY2012 from the IndFin historical database, FY2008-FY2015 from the yearly state-by-type files (IndFin preferred where both exist), FY2016-FY2024 from the Individual Unit Files (their FY2015, a 2020 release, is kept as a lower-priority candidate). From FY2013 a state government with no liquor-store item has no value, not a zero.

label: State liquor store expenditure, total (Census -90)
definition: Census liquor stores expenditure: purchase of liquor for resale and the provision and operation of government-maintained alcoholic beverage monopoly systems (current operations plus capital outlay), excluding law enforcement and licensing. Census 'liquor stores' are the alcoholic beverage distribution facilities of government monopoly systems, wholesale-only ones included; a value never codes the retail system. Beverage scope follows each state's monopoly and differs by state and year.
overlap_note: Equals current operations plus capital outlay; never add it to them. Revenue minus this amount is not a profit (Census: not an accounting statement).
notes: State government only. Census survey fiscal year (state's own fiscal year). Published in thousands of dollars; stored in dollars (multiplier 1000). FY1972 and FY1977-FY2012 from the IndFin historical database, FY2008-FY2015 from the yearly state-by-type files (IndFin preferred where both exist), FY2016-FY2024 from the Individual Unit Files (their FY2015, a 2020 release, is kept as a lower-priority candidate). From FY2013 a state government with no liquor-store item has no value, not a zero.

label: State liquor store expenditure, current operations (Census E90)
definition: Census item E90: current operation expenditure of government liquor stores, including the purchase of liquor for resale. Census formula E90 = total liquor stores expenditure minus capital outlay. Census 'liquor stores' are the alcoholic beverage distribution facilities of government monopoly systems, wholesale-only ones included; a value never codes the retail system. Beverage scope follows each state's monopoly and differs by state and year.
overlap_note: Part of total liquor store expenditure. Includes the cost of goods sold, not only operating costs.
notes: State government only. Census survey fiscal year (state's own fiscal year). Published in thousands of dollars; stored in dollars (multiplier 1000). FY1972 and FY1977-FY2012 from the IndFin historical database, FY2008-FY2015 from the yearly state-by-type files (IndFin preferred where both exist), FY2016-FY2024 from the Individual Unit Files (their FY2015, a 2020 release, is kept as a lower-priority candidate). From FY2013 a state government with no liquor-store item has no value, not a zero.

label: State liquor store expenditure, capital outlay (Census F90 + G90)
definition: Census liquor stores capital outlay: construction (F90) plus other capital outlay (G90) of government liquor stores. Census 'liquor stores' are the alcoholic beverage distribution facilities of government monopoly systems, wholesale-only ones included; a value never codes the retail system. Beverage scope follows each state's monopoly and differs by state and year.
overlap_note: Part of total liquor store expenditure.
notes: State government only. Census survey fiscal year (state's own fiscal year). Published in thousands of dollars; stored in dollars (multiplier 1000). FY1972 and FY1977-FY2012 from the IndFin historical database, FY2008-FY2015 from the yearly state-by-type files (IndFin preferred where both exist), FY2016-FY2024 from the Individual Unit Files (their FY2015, a 2020 release, is kept as a lower-priority candidate). From FY2013 a state government with no liquor-store item has no value, not a zero.

label: Personal income (BEA SAINC1)
definition: BEA SAINC1 line 1: income received by or on behalf of persons residing in the area (wages and salaries, supplements, proprietors' income, rental income, dividends, interest and personal current transfer receipts, less contributions for government social insurance, plus the adjustment for residence). Current dollars, calendar year.
notes: Published in millions of dollars; stored in dollars (multiplier 1,000,000). Each BEA release revises earlier years; the release is recorded with each value. A covariate, not an alcohol outcome.

label: Per capita personal income (BEA SAINC1)
definition: BEA SAINC1 line 3: personal income divided by total midyear population (Census Bureau estimates as BEA used them). Current dollars, calendar year.
denominator: BEA's midyear population (Census estimates of its vintage), not this dataset's pop_total_resident
notes: Published in dollars. BEA's denominator can differ from this dataset's Census series of another vintage. Each BEA release revises earlier years. A covariate, not an alcohol outcome.

label: Beer, wine and liquor stores: establishments (CBP, NAICS 445310)
definition: Number of private establishments with paid employees classified in NAICS 445310 (beer, wine and liquor stores) during the year. Excludes government-operated stores (for example state liquor stores in control states) and stores whose main activity is groceries.
notes: Never a count of all off-premises alcohol outlets: state-run stores are out of CBP's scope and grocery or convenience stores selling alcohol are classified elsewhere.

label: Beer, wine and liquor stores: employment (CBP, NAICS 445310)
definition: Paid employees of private NAICS 445310 establishments in the pay period including March 12. Excludes government-operated stores.
notes: Disclosure method changes in 2007 (noise added) and 2017 (no withheld cells); each is a comparability group. Withheld values are missing, not zero.

label: Drinking places (alcoholic beverages): establishments (CBP, NAICS 722410)
definition: Number of private establishments with paid employees classified in NAICS 722410 (bars, taverns, nightclubs and other drinking places primarily serving alcoholic beverages) during the year. Restaurants that serve alcohol are classified elsewhere.

label: Drinking places (alcoholic beverages): employment (CBP, NAICS 722410)
definition: Paid employees of private NAICS 722410 establishments in the pay period including March 12.
notes: Disclosure method changes in 2007 and 2017, as for liquor stores. Withheld values are missing, not zero.

label: Supermarkets and other grocery stores: establishments (CBP, NAICS 445110)
definition: Number of private establishments with paid employees classified in NAICS 445110 (supermarkets and other grocery retailers, except convenience stores) during the year.
notes: Context for the grocery channel: a count of grocery establishments, not of grocery stores licensed to sell alcohol.

label: Current alcohol use, high school students (YRBS)
definition: Percent of high school students who had at least one drink of alcohol on at least 1 day during the 30 days before the survey (YRBSS question H42). Weighted state or national estimate with 95% confidence limits.
notes: School-based survey; states take part in some years only. Not comparable with adult BRFSS measures (different ages, mode and questions).

label: First drink before age 13, high school students (YRBS)
definition: Percent of high school students who had their first drink of alcohol, other than a few sips, before age 13 years (YRBSS question H41).
notes: School-based survey; states take part in some years only.

label: Current binge drinking, high school students (YRBS, 2017 definition)
definition: Percent of high school students who had four or more drinks of alcohol in a row (female) or five or more (male) within a couple of hours on at least 1 day during the 30 days before the survey (YRBSS question H44, 2017).
notes: Sex-specific thresholds from 2017; the earlier five-or-more question is a different measure and is not loaded.

label: Traffic fatalities (FARS)
definition: Deaths within 30 days in crashes on public roads involving a motor vehicle in transport, summed over FARS crashes by the state where the crash happened (accident file, FATALS).
notes: Counted from the FARS file version pinned; NHTSA replaces a year's annual report file with a final file, so published totals for the same year can differ. Each state-year carries a 95% interval for count noise only (uncertainty@1.2): crashes are treated as Poisson events and the deaths in each crash as given (compound Poisson, scaled Garwood interval). It describes the underlying expected number that a year's crashes are a draw from, which is what a comparison of years or states needs; it is not a measurement error, because the count is a census of deaths, and the deaths that actually occurred carry no count noise.

label: Alcohol-impaired-driving fatalities (FARS, NHTSA definition)
definition: Deaths in fatal crashes in which at least one driver had a BAC of .08 g/dL or more, using NHTSA's ten multiple imputations of the highest driver BAC (MIDRVACC.CSV) for unreported BACs; the mean over the ten imputations, by the state where the crash happened.
notes: An imputation-based estimate, rounded to 0.1. It does not say alcohol caused the crash. Utah's per se limit has been .05 since 2018-12-30; this measure keeps the .08 threshold everywhere. The 95% interval combines compound-Poisson count noise (for the underlying expected number) with the spread between NHTSA's ten imputations of unreported driver BACs (Rubin's rules: W + (1 + 1/m)B, Student's t on Rubin's degrees of freedom, uncertainty@1.2). For the deaths that actually occurred only the imputation part applies: extra.realized_total holds that interval (t on 9 degrees of freedom), and extra.imputation_se its standard error. It does not say whether alcohol caused a crash.
